recs.x:
ilosopher Nick Bostrom in 2003. At first Universal Paperclips looks like a normal silly clicker game, but eventually it starts making you think about things you probably hadn't before: < [link] >. What I particularly appreciate is that it has several stages; each at first seems like a surprise, and yet within its context is 100% logical (if horrifying).

A nice video about the feeling it can give you is here (Universal Paperclips is about 1/2 way through):
"The Horror of Universal Paperclips and Space Engine"
